name: Ricardo Pérez
bio:
Ricardo Pérez's journey into motorsport finance began unconventionally, with a childhood fascination for the roaring engines at local rally races morphing into a deep understanding of the business side. After earning his degree in Economics from ITAM, he initially worked in corporate finance, honing his analytical skills and financial acumen. However, the call of motorsport proved too strong, leading him to take a significant pay cut to join a smaller racing team. His dedication and sharp financial management quickly elevated him through the ranks. 

Ricardo believes in a proactive approach to financial control, constantly seeking opportunities to optimize budgets and identify potential cost savings without compromising performance. He's renowned for his ability to navigate complex financial regulations and his knack for securing sponsorships. His reputation as a reliable and innovative financial controller has made him a sought-after asset in the world of motorsport. His time at Boutsen VDS has been marked by careful strategic investments, improving the team's financial stability.

What sets Ricardo apart is his willingness to embrace new technologies and approaches to financial management. He's not afraid to challenge the status quo and is always looking for ways to improve efficiency and transparency. His understanding of the sport and his financial experience allows him to be an invaluable asset to any racing team.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly combed back with a slight wave on top.
physical.description: Ricardo is a man of average height with a sturdy build and a warm, approachable demeanor.
